app.name: GearHut
app.domain_disjointness: gearhut is not among the 12 known v2 curriculum domains (train: aquarium artmarket filmset foodbank landregistry makerspace observatory recycling wildlife; dev: radiostation sportsarena tailorshop). The 24 holdout domains are sealed and unread; the app is a demonstration (not an evaluation), so holdout disjointness is not required for validity - recorded for transparency.
app.user_story: Manage GearItem records linked to GearLocker in the GearHut maintenance service.
app.crud_surface: Create (POST), Read (GET with filters), Update (PATCH advance-status via the state invariant), Delete (DELETE by id)

requirements: Write the Prisma models for GearLocker and GearItem, with correct one-to-many relation sides.
The GearItem.lockerId foreign key is required; its relation field must have matching nullability.
Use String @id @default(cuid()) primary keys and a usageHours Int field.
Declared delete semantics must match foreign-key optionality: SetNull if optional, Restrict if required.
The child model also stores status String @default("stashed"), persisted for UI/API workflows.
GearLocker also has an optional name String? field.
schema_contract.trusted_scaffold: datasource db { provider = "sqlite", url = env("DATABASE_URL") } + generator client { provider = "prisma-client-js" } is teacher-provided Next.js boilerplate (TRUSTED-SCAFFOLD); the model bytes are the generation target.

requirements: Export a pure predicate canAdvanceGearItem(record, locker) returning a boolean; it must never mutate its arguments.
When record.status is "stashed": return true exactly when locker is not null.
When record.status is "inspected": return true exactly when record.usageHours is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
When record.status is "retired" or any unrecognized status: return false.
No filesystem, network or database access.

get_requirements: GET /api/gearhut-items returns Response.json({ gear: rows, total }) where rows match the filters.
Query parameter search (optional): case-insensitive substring match on label; filter in the database with Prisma contains + LOWER().
Query parameter status (optional): exact status match; the value "all" or empty means no status filter.
total equals the number of FILTERED rows.
Import db from "@/lib/db" and use the global Response.json (no next/server import).
post_requirements: POST /api/gearhut-items creates a GearItem from a JSON body { label, usageHours, lockerId }.
400 with { error } when label is missing, not a string, or blank after trim.
400 with { error } when usageHours is not an integer between 0 and 2000.
404 with { error } when lockerId does not reference an existing GearLocker.
409 with { error } when a GearItem with the same label already exists.
On success persist with status "stashed" and return 201 with the created record as JSON.

teacher_extensions.patch: PATCH /api/gearhut-items/[id] { status } advances the item only when canAdvanceGearItem(current, locker) is true (200 + updated row); otherwise 409 with the invariant reason. TEACHER-CORRECTED code that makes the QWEN-generated invariant load-bearing.

react_requirements: Default-export a GearItemList({ data }) component that renders every row it receives through the data prop (no fetch).
A labeled search input filters rows by label case-insensitively.
A labeled status select offers all/stashed/inspected/retired and filters by exact status.
A Clear filters button resets both filters.
When no rows match, render an explicit empty state with data-testid="empty-state".
Render label, usageHours and status for each row.
integration_requirements: Default-export a GearItemManager({ lockers }) component that GETs /api/gearhut-items on mount and reads { gear, total }.
A create form with labeled label text input, usageHours number input and Locker select (options from the lockers prop, defaulting to the first) POSTs JSON { label, usageHours, lockerId }.
On 201 the visible list and total update without a page reload.
On failure the error message is visible (role="alert") and the form keeps its values.
Display the total number of items.
The list shows label, usageHours and status for each row.
ui_contract.teacher_assembly: src/app/page.tsx (server component) loads lockers from the database, wraps the generated manager in the shadcn/theme chrome (responsive, sticky footer) and is TEACHER-INTEGRATED; per-row advance/delete actions are teacher-added wiring around the generated core, disclosed in ATTRIBUTION.md.

generation_protocol.tier: UNSHARE_USERNS_DISCLOSED locally; Docker argv parity preserved for CI

api: GET no params: 200, gear array non-empty after seed, total matches
GET ?status=: exact match; all/empty = no filter
GET no match: empty array + total 0
POST valid: 201, status stashed, persisted (survives GET)
POST usageHours out of range or non-integer: 400
PATCH illegal advance (retired->stashed): 409 with invariant reason
ui_browser: initial render shows seeded items and total
status filter works; combined filters work
empty state visible on no match
create valid item: appears without page reload, total increments
create duplicate: error visible, form values preserved
advance action moves status through the workflow
responsive at 320px; footer sticks to bottom on short pages
test_plan_phase6.invariant_unit: the 7-case table from invariant_contract, run against the integrated src/lib/gear-invariant.ts
